EMERALD CHAMPIONS — MASTER BATTLE DESIGN
VERSION: 2
AUTHORING_STATUS: COMPLETE — STATICALLY AUDITED TRAINER-PARTY SOURCE OF TRUTH
REGENERATION_RULE: The battle_teams.txt catalog owns loadouts and plans; this file owns active encounter metadata and materializes that catalog. Encounter IDs are stable and may have gaps.
CHRONOLOGY_RULE: Live Inclement map scripts and flags own story reachability. This file owns trainer loadouts and battle metadata only; non-battle milestones in the playthrough manifest establish traversal order.

SCOPE
source_checkpoint: modern Pokemon Champions migration branch
rematch_free_physical_encounter_groups: 468
rematch_free_explicit_trainer_branch_blocks: 516
format_counts: derived from active branch records; retired encounter IDs remain reserved
doubles_policy: every campaign trainer battle is double or multi; the opening rival has four Pokemon and all standard opposing teams have at least four
excluded_content: ordinary Match Call tiers, Gym rematch families, and three phantom source-parser hits
included_content: every current Hoenn trainer reference plus 18 explicitly planned one-time bespoke restorations
battle_frontier_boundary: every live Frontier challenge desk enters the single endless Champions Circuit, generated in-ROM from the pinned Showdown Champions random-doubles port; the retired native facility generators are not campaign encounters

DESIGN THESIS
Every campaign battle is a bespoke, legal, readable puzzle. The player receives competitive Pokemon, moves, abilities, natures, Stat Points, and free ordinary held items; difficulty comes from decisions rather than grinding.
All campaign trainers use max(authored level, live badge cap), then the difficulty offset: Hard 0, Normal -2, Easy -4. Gyms and the opening doubles are included. Teams and expert AI stay identical across difficulty settings.
Mega Evolution is the only selectable gimmick. No Mega appears before the post-Brawly bracelet. Primals remain approved automatic forms.

CLOSED GLOBAL AUDIT
champions_legality_repairs: 584 move slots normalized against Showdown bb179fbf8449e3c31632bd56f671ffb4404fa6e7
coverage: all 99 Mega Stones and all 76 Legendary Sign species appear in opponent teams
cohesion_contract: exact authored/native materialization, live-cap levels, valid native moves/forms/abilities/items and 66/32 Stat Points; roster-pattern and reference comparisons are advisory, not design quotas.

REMATCH POLICY
Ordinary and Gym rematches are not campaign content. League replays reuse the finished League teams. Gabby and Ty remain only as distinct roaming reporter milestones. Repeatable endgame variety belongs to the live Champions Circuit reached from every Frontier challenge desk.

IMPLEMENTATION CONTRACT
Implement every retained branch exactly: format, cap-relative levels, species, item, ability, nature, Stat Points, moves, AI requirements, and native dialogue intent. Compile after each 100 implemented encounters, then run source, static, emulator, save, and full-progression gates.

battle_class: regular
ai_profile: sharp
primary_question: Can the player beat this regular team (Pikachu, Paras, Slakoth, Bunnelby) on its own terms: Fast Light Ball Pikachu can Fake Out one foe while bulky Paras Spores the other. Paras can instead use priority Wide Guard to protect both partners from spread attacks while Pikachu commits to Volt Tackle; Leech Life supplies actual damage and recovery when support is unnecessary. Choice Band Slakoth is a reserve wallbreaker, not a claim that sleep removes Truant. Huge Power Bunnelby gives the second phase reliable Frustration at its native zero trainer friendship alongside priority, Rock Slide coverage and a pivot out of an unfavorable lock or matchup.
theme_and_tempo: Fast Light Ball Pikachu can Fake Out one foe while bulky Paras Spores the other. Paras can instead use priority Wide Guard to protect both partners from spread attacks while Pikachu commits to Volt Tackle; Leech Life supplies actual damage and recovery when support is unnecessary. Choice Band Slakoth is a reserve wallbreaker, not a claim that sleep removes Truant.
